T2. Yokai are tricksters and lonely spirits, not monsters. A yokai that wins walks away or goes back to what it was doing; it never hurts Ryo for pleasure and never gloats over him. (Source: rules.md S1; vault Tone#The tone line, Story#Wake-up cards)
T3. Melancholy is small and specific: something owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind. Never doom, despair or the end of the world. (Source: vault Tone#Do and don't examples)
T4. The merchant and the Tanuki share one voice: cheerful, generous and quietly hungry. It compliments what it wants, teases Ryo as "little exorcist" and never shouts, threatens or sounds evil.
